speed.method: launch command issued -> App os_log "lane-ready" (first data-bearing screen), App terminated 3 s before each run, first run after install discarded, median; only the discarded first launch carried the warm-up arguments (sign-in), timed launches reopen with the stored session

idle.method: shared measure.py idle: CPU-time delta / wall window; phys_footprint peak of 3 samples after the window
idle.scope: Simulator App host process only; excludes CoreSimulator, system services and inactive extensions
